metadata.name: OPCoach MCP Mail
metadata.description: An open-source MCP server that runs locally and connects to your own IMAP/SMTP mailbox. Search, read, send and organize mail from an MCP client. Mailbox credentials are configured locally.

config.notes: Requires Java 24 or later. Download the versioned JAR and SHA-256 from https://github.com/opcoach/opcoach-mcp-mail/releases/tag/v1.0.0 and verify the checksum. Replace <absolute-path-to-jar> with the downloaded JAR's absolute path. Run java -jar <absolute-path-to-jar> config setup in a terminal to configure your own IMAP/SMTP mailbox and store its password locally. On Linux, provide MAIL_MCP_VAULT_PASSWORD privately to the MCP client process so it can unlock the local vault without prompting on stdin. Let the MCP client launch the server; do not include credentials in the server configuration.
